findings.title: Multiple H1 headings on a page
findings.evidence: 2 page(s) declare more than one H1, e.g. https://www.python.org/, diluting the topic signal.

suggested_action.summary: Use a single H1 for the main topic and H2/H3 for sub-sections to give a clean outline.

findings.why: A fact locked in an image or missing its text anchor can't be extracted or quoted.

findings.title: No XML sitemap found
findings.evidence: Neither /sitemap.xml nor a Sitemap: directive in robots.txt was found.

suggested_action.summary: Publish an XML sitemap and reference it from robots.txt so crawlers discover all key pages efficiently.

findings.why: If the crawler can't fetch the page, no AI assistant can ever cite it.

findings.title: Deep pages lack breadcrumbs / positional context
findings.evidence: 4 deep page(s) show no breadcrumb trail, so visitors landing mid-site can't tell where they are or move up a level.

suggested_action.summary: Add a breadcrumb trail (and BreadcrumbList schema) on deep pages so visitors keep their bearings and explore laterally.

findings.why: Disoriented visitors who can't tell where they are or where to go bounce.

notes: Crawled 8 page(s) in 7042 ms; 11 HTTP request(s). Static, read-only analysis.
